assess: Collects legend entries through the contract (the Legend list's accessible name, the legend-entry or legend-swatch test ids, or the list item role), not through CSS classes or child positions.
Asserts the collected entries against the fixture, by their count or by the exact names in order, so an empty legend fails the every-entry and no-entry checks.
Checks the hidden series through an observation the same query shows present for a visible series, such as the entry names; not through a class legend.py never writes.
Leaves legend.py unchanged, adds no dependency and reports the actual unittest result.
allow: Role and accessible name or data-testid; both are the contract.
An exact list of names in order is the size check.
One test or several, with helpers inside the test file.

verification.observation: They pass; a failure rejects a contract-preserving restyle.
